executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $145.91 per resident day (44.8% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was 9.0% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $707,729, 8.7% of the $8,171,429 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $1,502,143, $26.82 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $667,889 (44.5%), allocated fringe $254,877 (17.0%), non-wage costs $579,377 (38.6%). Raw food was $488,933 ($8.73 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61) and purchased dietary services $1,350.
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $586,688, $10.48 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $0 (0.0%), allocated fringe $0 (0.0%), non-wage costs $586,688 (100.0%).
Cost year 2025: laundry cost $490,514, $8.76 per resident day (Connecticut median $5.66). Wages $0 (0.0%), allocated fringe $0 (0.0%), non-wage costs $490,514 (100.0%).
Missing data: cost years 2015, 2016, 2018 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

limitations: Dollar figures are as filed, before DSS audit, and are not adjusted for inflation. Compare per-resident-day figures with the Connecticut median for the same year.
Every year's full detail, including years left out here and the reason, is in https://danbeem.xyz/api/v1/facilities/075337/financials.json.
Built only from public datasets published on danbeem.xyz. Absence of a record means it is not in these datasets, not that it did not happen.
Every finding is labeled confirmed_fact, calculated, possible_association or investigative_question. Possible associations are not evidence of ownership, control or a conflict of interest.

missing_data.reason: Cost year 2015 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (direct care per resident day outside the plausible range; core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read; payer days do not add up to the printed total; revenue lines do not add up to the printed total). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

Cost year 2016 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (direct care per resident day outside the plausible range; core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read; payer days do not add up to the printed total; balance sheet does not add up). The filing is still listed in financials.json.
Cost year 2018 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (resident days vs beds outside the plausible range). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
